title: ARA LLM Call
description: One row of llm/calls.jsonl. Legacy rows may reference redacted payload objects; digest_receipt_v1 rows reference payload-free digest envelopes and a semantic call receipt.

trace_format.description: Absent on legacy ara.v1 rows. digest_receipt_v1 guarantees digest-only message/response objects plus call_receipt_ref.

call_id.description: Unique per invocation; not stable across runs.

ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the call completed.

stage.description: Which pipeline stage produced the call (ideation / planning / bfts_draft / bfts_debug / review / repair / writeup / …). Free-form.

model.description: Model id as passed by the caller (e.g. anthropic/glm-5.1).

model_provenance.description: Secret-free resolved provider contract. Endpoints are represented by hashes and credentials by environment-variable names.

params.description: Hash-worthy request knobs (temperature, max_tokens, seed, top_p, response_format, tool_choice, stop). Non-serialisable values MUST be omitted, not stringified.

messages_ref.description: Legacy redacted messages, or a payload-free messages digest envelope for digest_receipt_v1.

response_ref.description: Legacy redacted response text, or a payload-free response digest envelope for digest_receipt_v1.

call_receipt_ref.description: Content-addressed semantic receipt binding payload digests, provider/model identity, and request parameters.

error.description: Optional sanitized error category; never provider payload, endpoint, or credential text.
